result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of twelve months’ fees and USD 1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes Company’s fee-payment obligations from the cap. The revisions are appropriately limited to the liability allocation. Drafting is professional, although the fee lookback is measured from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim itself, a minor deviation from the preferred wording.
